title: Trust the Lord
verse: for they all saw him and were terrified. But immediately he spoke to them: “Have courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.
observation: Jesus was right in the middle of their darkest moment. People died at sea all the time. Being a fisherman was not an easy job. They likely had known people who died at sea, and they might have thought it was their turn. Nope. Jesus was willing to change the laws of nature to get to His people.
application: Trust the Lord. Even when it looks impossible, Jesus can change it.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for letting nothing stop You from getting to us.
